title: Python attribute-write read-side one-path consumers (DEC-303 a79/a80 GCLI-151b)
description: Record-only held task, the read-side one-path half (leader label GCLI-151b) of GCLI-151 split under DEC-303 (a80) item 6 (opum-ai/opum-doc#2083, ODOC-640). Scope is the read consumers, each a resolution path that does not consult an already recorded write: (1) Q-B the defining module bare f() after an importer writes m.f; (5) from m import inst; inst.m = other; inst.m(); (7) (a80) B1 a written class name in a BASE position class D(m.C); (8) (a80) B1b a written class name in a two-argument super() first argument; (9) (a80) B2 k = self.__class__; k.m(); (10) the dev enclosing-class fallback for an unresolved super() first argument; (12) N2 a star importer bare f(); (13) N3 classSymbolOfName with from m import C and m.C = other; (14) N4 a decorator @C.m after C.m = other; (16) N6 C.__init__ = other leaving the construction edge. Depends on GCLI-154: #7, #8 and #13 consume the record #3 adds there. Dev results measured 2026-11-27 at origin/dev 1ea3432; every shape is a wrong edge on dev. The (a80) fixtures for B1, B1b and B2 already pin the wrong edge and must flip to refusal here. If the ten shapes overflow two review rounds, use the pre-agreed sub-split, module-attribute reads (#1, #7, #8, #10, #12, #13) and class-attribute reads (#5, #9, #14, #16), and tell the leader BEFORE building. Removal-only; #10 removes dev edges, which are named with the PR; any created in-repo edge comes to opum-doc via the leader before the PR.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every read-side shape KEPT in #238 has a red-before green-after refused fixture with a resolving twin: #5, #8, #8b, #10 and #16. #9 is a LABELLED CONTROL, green on dev and head, measured NOT wrong at 1ea3432 and 1887cd0 across nine variants, DEC-303 (a87) item 1. #1, #7, #12, #13 and #14 are OUT of #238 under the DEC-303 (a86) item 2 fallback, moved to GCLI-159, and their fixtures pin dev outcome.
A mutant per kept read path is observed red on its predicted fixture, and a mutant per removed shape that re-enables the removed code is observed red on that shape dev-outcome fixture

Removal-only holds: the subset check with flags over the five pins, every fixture and the corpus shows no created in-repo edge and no flag-changed edge, with an observed-red control and a group floor; every removed edge is named in the PR

The (a80) B1 and B1b fixtures flip to refusal. B2 (#9) does NOT flip: it was a CREATED edge only at the head of #233, dev gave receiver 1 and no edge, and the shape is a labelled control, DEC-303 (a87) items 1 and 2.
No DEC-182 path class is touched and no dependency is added

plan: 1. Read GCLI-155 and DEC-303 (a78)-(a84) on opum-doc by ref; measure all ten shapes on origin/dev with with-write/without-write twins.
2. Write the red-before/green-after fixtures with resolving twins and (a83) item-2 reads (written attribute, neighbour, receiver, before/after), plus the (a80) B1/B1b/B2 flips.

3. Gate each read path in src/python/calls.ts: bare-name module read (#1,#12), M1 reader (#5), base resolution (#7), super() first argument and its fallback (#8,#8b,#10), classSymbolOfName (#13), decorator path (#14), construction __init__ edge (#16); keep baseAlternatives write-blind for #9.

4. Mutate each read path and confirm a predicted subset of fixtures goes red; run the flag-extended subset check over the five pins, the 1394-source corpus and every fixture with an observed-red control.
5. Normalize (typecheck, lint, format, full suite), commit on the task branch, open the PR, and report the PR number, head SHA and proof numbers to the leader.
implementationNotes: SPLIT under DEC-303 (a80) item 6 from GCLI-151. This is the read-side one-path half (leader label GCLI-151b); the binder half is GCLI-154, the heavy reads are the heavy task. All three hold the (a36) item 8 pre-registration and come ahead of GCLI-141 to 143.

SHAPE TABLE, dev measured 2026-11-27 at origin/dev 1ea3432, via analyzePythonCalls with with-write/without-write twins: #1 wrong edge m.py:f; #5 wrong edge m.py:C.m (importedInstanceClass has no write check); #7 wrong edge m.py:C.m in base position (needs GCLI-154 #3); #8 wrong edge app.py:B.m via the enclosing fallback (needs GCLI-154 #3); #9 (a80) B2 carry, dev receiver/no-edge and #233 C.m, both wrong; #10 wrong edge m.py:A.m, its fix REMOVES dev edges that are named with the PR; #12 wrong edge m.py:f via resolveStarBound; #13 wrong edges m.py:C.m (both, classSymbolOfName bypass, needs GCLI-154 #3); #14 wrong edge C.m via the decorator path; #16 wrong edge C.__init__ via the construction path.

(a80) deliberately keeps the module-attribute gate write-blind in a class-name base position and a two-argument super() first argument; #7 and #8 turn the gate on in exactly those positions, and #10 fixes the enclosing-class fallback. Each must be tested for created edges, including what the fallback resolves to after the change.
Files expected: src/python/calls.ts and test/python-hops.test.ts. No DEC-182 path class; no dependency.

Implementation (head 056be9c): nine src hunks in calls.ts gate the ten read paths. #1/#12 in resolveBareName's module-scope arm (GCLI-144/146 class-body reads untouched); #5 in the M1 reader; #7 by resolving a base with the mod.f gate ON, while baseAlternatives reads it write-blind so dev's descendant relationships survive (#9 stays refused, and a (a80) base-position pin is unchanged); #8/#8b by resolving the super() first argument with the gate ON, and #10 by refusing when a two-argument super() first argument resolves to no class instead of falling back to the enclosing class; #13 in classSymbolOfName's from-import arm; #14 in resolveCalleeToSymbol's class-attribute arm plus a collectAttributeWrites() call in resolveDecoratorSite (decorators ran after the call loop, so a module with no call never collected the write sets); #16 by dropping the construction's __init__ edge when a class-level __init__ write precedes the MRO's supplying def. Removal-only subset check over 1433 groups (five pins, 1394-source corpus, 34 fixtures) with flags: 0 created edges; pins unchanged edge-for-edge (flask 1366, httpx 2791, jinja 2833, rich 7410, tqdm 981); 20 removed edges, all in the wrong-edge fixtures, including #9b's k.m() (a descendant with a rebound base fails closed on self.__class__, a consequence of #7). Observed-red control injected one created edge in a pin and one in a fixture, and the check reported both. Full suite 1332 pass.

Round 2 fix (DEC-303 (a86) item 1), one commit on 4e7e18b. The MRO is built write-blind as dev does; a base whose name a recorded write rebinds keeps its place, marked GATED, and every lookup that reaches or crosses it refuses (methodLookup, firstMethodEntry, instanceClassOf), never falling through to the next base; collectAttributeWrites runs with all three gates off and the #14 class-write check respects the bypass. Proof: subset check over 1466 groups (five pins + 1394 corpus + 67 fixtures) = 0 created, 0 flag-changed, floor enforced (fails if fewer), observed-red control reported both injected created edges and the floor guard fired when raised; pins unchanged edge for edge; 39 removed edges, 22 bin changes, all fixtures. The ten created-edge fixtures are red at 4e7e18b and green at the new head, plus #9b (red there because its edge was removed at 4e7e18b, green now). Item 4 measurement: #9's with-write twin and every variant (V1-V9) are IDENTICAL at 1ea3432 and 1887cd0, so GCLI-154 did not fix #9 and the (a86) item 4 condition does not hold; AC1/AC4 were therefore NOT amended, and #9 stays a labelled control pending the ruling. Full suite 1352 pass.

DEC-303 (a86) item 2 fallback applied at round 2 on 2b3a2ba: R1 was confirmed (a CREATED k.m edge and POLY drops in the same-module try/except, if/else and star-importer variants, attr-arm control dev-equal), so #1, #7, #12, #13, #14 and the machinery that existed only for them are OUT of #238 and moved to GCLI-159. GCLI-155 keeps #5, #8/#8b, #10 and #16, and its acceptance criteria are amended to that reduced scope per DEC-303 (a87) (the GCLI-158 handoff's pending amendment, adjusted). All removed-shape fixtures stay and pin dev's outcome.

LANDED at dev 88baaa9102c17a2fab22b4e06d1970a5c7daeaa0 via opum-ai/glyph-cli#238 (squash, merged 2026-11-27T07:38:05Z; PR head fd69b44 under a head-pinned clear). Evidence for the five reduced ACs: (1) kept-shape fixtures #5, #8/#8b, #10 and #16 with resolving twins, and #9 as the labelled control per DEC-303 (a87); the removed shapes' fixtures pin dev outcome. (2) mutants at the landed code: K1 disables the #5 gate and turns #5 and #5-order red; K2 restores the enclosing fallback and turns eight #8/#8b/#10 fixtures red; K3 drops the init check and turns #16 and #16b red; M1 and M2 and M3 and M4 re-enable the removed #1/#12 gate, #13 gate, #14 gate plus collection, and the full 2b3a2ba machinery, each red on its dev-outcome fixtures. (3) flag-extended subset over 1483 groups (five pins plus 1394 corpus plus 84 fixtures), floor 1483: 0 created, 0 flag-changed, pins unchanged edge for edge (flask 1366, httpx 2791, jinja 2833, rich 7410, tqdm 981), 17560 dev and 17546 head edges, 14 removed and 10 bin changes, all fixtures; observed-red and floor controls both behaved. constructorNotes equal on dev and head over the same 1483 groups (10 groups carry notes, 1560 notes, 0 differences). (4) B1 and B1b flip to refusal, B2 #9 does not. (5) the diff is src/python/calls.ts (four hunks against dev, +31/-8), test/python-hops.test.ts and the two .quest records; no dependency added. quest task start was refused as In Progress -> In Progress, so no start transition is recorded.
finalSummary: Read-side one-path half of GCLI-151 (151b), reduced by the DEC-303 (a86) item 2 fallback after round 2 blocked on R1. opum-ai/glyph-cli#238 lands #5 (imported-instance local write), #8/#8b and #10 (two-argument super first argument) and #16 (construction __init__ edge); #1, #7, #12, #13, #14 and the gated-MRO machinery are out and held in GCLI-159. Landed at dev 88baaa9. Verified by the flag-extended subset over 1483 groups (0 created, 0 flag-changed, floor met, observed-red and floor controls), constructorNotes equality over the same groups (0 differences), kept-path mutants K1-K3 and removed-shape mutants M1-M4, and the full local gate (typecheck clean, lint only the pre-existing useConst warning, format clean, 1353 tests pass).
